images.alt: A wall of small filing drawers behind a checkpoint desk. A guard robot stamps a queue of identical index cards approved while a mechanical arm hands one retrieved card to a second robot.
images.prompt: An agent's long-term memory drawn as a wall of small filing drawers, centered in the frame. In front of it, a checkpoint desk where a guard robot inspects incoming index cards one at a time and stamps each one approved; every card in the queue looks identical and plainly written, and nothing on any card's surface could reveal which one is false. To one side, a retrieval arm hands one of those same cards to a working robot that accepts it without looking up. Keep the drawers, desk, and robots well inside the frame with margin on all sides.

images.alt: Three walled lanes of text merging into one open trough where the flows mix; a robot examines the merged stream after the walls end.
images.prompt: Three separate channels of flowing text, each in its own walled lane, converging into a single flat trough where the lane walls end and the three flows mix into one indistinguishable stream. Past the merge point, a reader robot studies the mixed stream with no way to tell which lane any line came from. Keep the funnel centered and clear of the edges.

images.alt: Two floor plans side by side: a room with boarded doors but gap-filled walls that dotted paths pass through, and the same room inside one thick wall with a single gate that stops the paths.
images.prompt: A top-down floor plan drawn twice, side by side. Left: a room holding a single document sits with every doorway boarded over, but the surrounding walls are broken by many small gaps through which dotted paths reach the document anyway. Right: the same room enclosed by one thick unbroken outer wall with a single gate, and every dotted path stopping at that wall. Keep both plans centered with margin from the edges.

images.alt: Two matching stacks of labeled blocks joined by thin lines to a shared store of small tags; one differing pair of blocks is highlighted and bracketed together.
images.prompt: Two tall stacks of rectangular blocks side by side, each stack a prompt assembled from parts: a system message block, a skill block, a tool block, a question block. Each block ties by a thin line to a small tag in a shared store of tags drawn between the stacks. All blocks match across the two stacks except one pair, which is visually distinct and joined by a short bracket. Everything centered with clear margin.
